profile.headline: Sr Software Developer at Duke Energy
profile.summary:
Versatile and results-driven professional in software development and a strong focus on data analysis and visualization. Proficient in designing and implementing highly interactive web applications using Angular, JavaScript, TypeScript, and integrating RESTful APIs, while also leveraging tools like Power BI, SQL, Azure Data Factory, and Databricks to deliver actionable insights and optimize data pipelines.

Skilled in building interactive dashboards, developing data-driven solutions, and managing complex applications that enhance operational efficiency and support strategic decision-making. Strong knowledge of web technologies such as HTML5, CSS3, Bootstrap, and responsive design principles, combined with expertise in data analysis tools like MS Excel, Tabular Editor, and PySpark.

Experienced in Agile project management and proficient in tools like JIRA for task tracking and delivery. Adept at collaborating with cross-functional teams to deliver high-quality, client-focused solutions that align with business goals and compliance standards.

Passionate about bridging the gap between software development and data analytics, I thrive on solving complex problems, delivering innovative solutions, and driving business decisions through data. With a strong foundation in both application development and data analysis, I bring a unique perspective to every project, ensuring impactful results and continuous improvement.

projects.title: Auto Loan Web Application
projects.description:
• Implemented controls such as user-controls, list views, editing and validation, modal popups and Ajax extenders, dropdown lists, file uploaders, query strings, SQL Data source.
• Developed a web-based application that allows the user to get an auto loan from a private party or dealer. Users can get quotes for the loan. Users can rate the dealer or private party. Users can also see the advertisements posted by dealers and private parties. Implemented CRUD operations. Performed unit testing and code reviews.

projects.title: Organic Shop – Ecommerce Web Application
projects.description:
Developed an application with two types of users. 1) Admin can manage the products and orders placed by customers. 2) User can login using google login, view product list page, view product details page and add products to the shopping cart.
Implemented Sorting, searching functionalities for both roles.
